Recorded on 2026-11-05 from the identity hub of RFC 133 PR 1 (PR 1898, identity-broker 0.16.0) by a throwaway hub test, "records the answers", that posted to `POST /hub-clients` in apps/identity-hub's convex-test backend with GitHub tokens for `prod` and `pr-12`; the secret values are replaced by `REDACTED`.

On 2026-11-07, for 0.33.0, each answer gained `"connectors": ["google"]`, the set that the request of RFC 137 enrolls and the hub repeats; the other fields are as recorded.

`register-development.json` was recorded on 2026-11-05 from the same hub (v2267) by a throwaway hub test, "records the development answer", that posted to `POST /hub-clients` with the initial access token of a production registration and the return address `https://happy-otter-123.convex.site/auth/hub/callback`; the secret values are replaced by `REDACTED`.

On 2026-11-11 the hub's endpoint became `POST /register`, and its 201 answer became the client information response of RFC 7591 section 3.2.1. So each answer gained the members that the hub's `clientInformation` writes for its recorded request: `client_id_issued_at` (2026-11-05 in seconds), `client_secret_expires_at`, `client_name` (`prod`, `pr-12`, or `development`), `software_id` and `software_version` (`my-app` and `abc123`, the body of the hub test), `token_endpoint_auth_method` (`client_secret_post`, which the hub of that test registered and `IdentityHub.Client` sends), `grant_types`, and `response_types`. The members are in the order of the hub's answer, and the files have the name of the new endpoint. The other values are as recorded.

Each answer also gained `application_type` (`web`), `subject_type` (`public`), and `id_token_signed_response_alg` (`RS256`), after `response_types`, and its `software_id` is the full form that the hub answers, `gh-74/my-app`: 74 is the `repository` of the production answer, and the three answers come from the same repository.
